Mira Patel: Hey folks! Mira here — first day at Redwood Inference 👋 Remote in Toronto. Slightly wobbling because I brought a giant plush penguin named Pippin to my desk and I'm wondering if that's... normal? :penguin:
Jo Rivera: 100% normal. bring pics! also welcome 🎉
Kai Nakamura: Welcome Mira! If Pippin needs a badge let me know 😄
Aviya Shah: Welcome!! We have a weekly 'desk pet' leaderboard in random — Pippin could win day 1 :trophy:
Mira Patel: attaching pic: https://imgur.com/xyz123 (very cuddly). Also quick question — is there a preferred coffee order to put on the team list? I'm partial to oat latte ☕
Luc: Oat latte for life. Adding you to the SF coffee slack thread, @Mira Patel
People Ops Bot: Mira Patel added to #all-hands, #devex, and the lunch scheduling doc. Welcome package delivery ETA: 2 days.
Noah: Welcome! Also heads up — sticker wall by the kitchen has limited space, people trade stickers weekly. You in? :sticker:
Mira Patel: 100% — I have a penguin sticker pack. Also down for plant swaps. Anyone want a small pothos? :seedling:
Jo Rivera: I'll take the pothos if it's pet-friendly. Ping me for handoff.
Kai Nakamura: Welcome again! If you want a keyboard sticker, I have extra rainbow keys.
Mira Patel: You all are the best. Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to ship things with you all. Happy to grab virtual coffee this week if anyone's free! :smile:
Aviya Shah: Added a 15-min coffee slot tomorrow at 10:30am PT. See you there :calendar:
Noah: Also, mandatory team mascot vote: Pippin vs. Kai's cat. Place your emoji now :penguin: or :cat:
Luc: :penguin:
Jo Rivera: :penguin:
Kai Nakamura: :cat: (biased)
Mira Patel: :penguin: obviously
People Ops Bot: Poll recorded: 4 penguins, 1 cat — Pippin leads 🐧
